notes.title: Save/Load-Upade
notes.content:
[h1][b]The latest update is finally available[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]I managed to introduce saving and loading just in time for the winter sales.[/b][/h3]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] save and load has been added
[*] christmas decoration has been added which is always active from 22.12. to 6.1.
[/list]

[h2][b]Merry Christmas to all, stay healthy and see you next year with new content and much more[/b][/h2]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Some names of items and objects were displayed incorrectly in the German translation, this has been corrected.
[*]In the inventory menu, the titles and descriptions of the objects were not displayed correctly, this has been corrected.
[*]In chapter 2, a door had an incorrect animation, this has been corrected.

[*]The ceiling was missing in a room in the last chapter, this has been corrected. 

[*]The animation of Sophie was incorrect and has been corrected.

[/list]
